name: io.github.zhouhengchang/code-refactor
title: Code Refactor
description: Refactor legacy code into modern, idiomatic code without changing its behavior.

environmentVariables.name: REFACTOR_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Inference backend: 'ollama' (local, code stays on your machine, default) or 'openai' (any OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint, e.g. DeepSeek).

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1. Required when REFACTOR_BACKEND=openai.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the cloud endpoint, e.g. a DeepSeek key. Only needed when REFACTOR_BACKEND=openai.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Ollama server address used when REFACTOR_BACKEND=ollama.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama model name used when REFACTOR_BACKEND=ollama.

environmentVariables.name: REFACTOR_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds. Raise it for slow local CPU inference.
